text_block_list.name: Gentil's Father
text_block_list.text:
Gentil. Your power is already overwhelming.
I've heard 
that at Tracen Academy,
your strength has no equal.

text_block_list.name: Gentil's Father
text_block_list.text:
But sometimes I wonder.
Why have you chosen to stay in that world?
I've also heard that you've 
accepted a rematch with someone you
defeated……

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Aahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I must apologize,
father. No matter how much I 
train and refine myself in that world――it
always 
whispers to me, to become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
……in the end,
all that will remain is the body and 
mind of the strong.
Races are the simplest and 
most spectacular way to prove your
"Strength".

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huu-……! Huu-……!

text_block_list.name: Mid-rank Trainer
text_block_list.text:
……Verxina. That girl, she's switched to a 
more intense and heavy menu than before……

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ……Is this spot open?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ……it's……all yours……!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I've already thrown away the person I was
when I lost 
to you. All of my strategies, training menu,
all of it.

――The day of Gentildonna and Verxina's
race. 
The spectator seats were filled with Uma
Musume 
and trainers that had heard the rumors.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Aah……what good timing, you over there. 
Rookie Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Would you record the time? 
All of it, until the goal.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
……――Are you more tense than yesterday? 
You went to the gym at noon too,
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Yesterday night,
and this morning too. And up until now. 
I've been spending the necessary time in
the necessary places.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Next time,
I won't let you get away. I'll run 
fast enough that you won't be able to get
away. 
That's precisely what I've been training
for.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: …………I see.

And then both of them take their positions
in 
silence. It was a long,
prolonged silence――

And then the silence was broken by the 
sound of feet kicking off of the turf!!

text_block_list.name: Gentil & Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Daaaaaaaaaaaaaah! 
Yaaaaaaaaaaaaa!

The two of them remain neck-and-neck,
overflowing with fighting spirit,
and each fighting for victory. 
The atmosphere was all consuming,
and then――

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa……Haaa……Kuu――!
――Gentildonna won by a nose.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ………… ……what was my time?

At Gentildonna's words,
I look at my stopwatch. The time was……

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I see, faster than before. 
………………

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Verxina, you've gotten stronger. However,
I was able to become 
even stronger than that. That is reality,
the unshakable truth.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ――……Kuu, but even then!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even if that's the case…… I will continue
to 
challenge you……! I'll figure out why I lose,
and fix it,
as many hundreds of times as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Until the day I surpass you! 
I'll still continue――……to seek strength!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Very good!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That is how a racer should be!
Even if you stumble 
and are covered in mud. Wipe yourself off,
stand 
again and surpass the you from yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Continue challenging me,
to become strong. 
To prove that you are the stronger one.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Shave away all your imperfections……so that
I can truly become the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Our "Strength" is for smashing through the
barriers 
before us.
All so that we can accomplish what we
desire.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
――And then I, with this body, with this 
power, will prove that I am the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
……I'll excuse myself here. 
From now on, be prepared.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. ……be well.

Gentildonna watched Verxina leave.
A rival with the "power" 
to stand against her. She stood as a noble,
towering above.

Was there a trainer that wouldn't admire
that strength?
Was there a trainer who wouldn't 
want to see where that strength would
lead?

Even when I had returned to my room,
my excitement hadn't faded.
I wrote down all the training 
ideas that came to me,
one after the other.

text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna's action all were for the sake
of honing 
her strength.
Whether it be listening to my guidance, 
or inspiring Verxina to continue to fight.

……She loves racing. 
This world was full of rivals all competing
to defeat her.

She wanted to match them, to compete,
to stand side-by-side. 
And then, in this world,
prove her overwhelming strength.

That's why she favors someone with
"strength". 
To create a partner that would never
falter―― 
all to bring out her own full potential.

……I reach my hand out to the shining lights
in the ceiling.

I need to prove I have "strength" too.
……more 
than anyone else. Even more than her.
I believe I 
have the "power" to draw out her true
strength.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You say you have a suggestion for me?
